query: Recent PLA aircraft activity around Taiwan ADIZ in May-June 2026, and reported pause or drop in activity. What are typical daily counts recently and highest single-day count in 2026?
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's a summary of the key findings on PLA aircraft activity around Taiwan's ADIZ in May–June 2026:

## Key Findings

**Overall trajectory:** PLA air activity has declined steadily through 2026 (Jan ~270 → Feb ~190 → March 173 sorties, a ~60% year-over-year drop), with each month Jan–May being the lowest for its corresponding month since January 2023 — even as naval activity surged to record levels.

**Typical recent daily counts (May–June 2026):** Low single digits to low double digits — e.g., 13 (May 18–19), 10 (May 27), 6 (June 13), and as few as 2 (June 25–26). Notably, **no single day in May 2026 exceeded 30 sorties.**

**The reported pause:** The major lull was **~Feb 28 to mid-March 2026** — near-zero activity for 13 consecutive days, coinciding with China's "Two Sessions." Media reported Taiwan detected no Chinese aircraft for nine of ten days. Experts floated five theories but reached no consensus. Subdued activity continued through May–June.

**Highest single-day count in 2026:** **June 22–23, 2026 — 130 aircraft detected, 90 crossing the median line**, the second-highest one-day median-line total on record. This nearly matched the all-time record of Dec 29, 2025 (130 aircraft / 90 crossings, Justice Mission).

**Important caveat:** The air decline is partly offset by record naval activity (225 PLAN vessels in June 2026, highest June on record), which analysts interpret as pressure shifting to maritime/long-range operations rather than genuine de-escalation.

key_facts: June 2026: 214 total PLA aircraft sorties and 134 median-line crossings — substantially below June 2024 and June 2025.
Highest single-day count in 2026: June 22–23, 2026, with 130 PLA aircraft detected and 90 crossing the median line — the second-highest one-day median-line total on record.
In May 2026, no single day recorded more than 30 detected aircraft sorties; the last day exceeding 30 was March 17, 2026 (36 aircraft).
Major pause: ~Feb 28–mid-March 2026, near-zero air activity for 13 consecutive days coinciding with China's 'Two Sessions'; Taiwan detected no aircraft for nine of ten days.
Monthly totals declined steadily: Jan ~270, Feb ~190, March 173 (~60% YoY decline vs. 431 in March 2025).
Each month Jan–May 2026 was the lowest for its corresponding month since January 2023 (per analyst K. Tristan Tang).
Typical recent daily counts May–June 2026 ranged from 2 to ~13 sorties (e.g., 13 on May 18–19, 10 on May 27, 6 on June 13, 2 on June 25–26).
Naval activity rose sharply: 225 PLAN vessels in June 2026, the highest June total on record; analysts see pressure shifting to maritime operations.
All-time single-day record was Dec 29, 2025 (Justice Mission-2025): 130 aircraft / 90 median-line crossings; June 22–23 2026 nearly matched it.
No single explanation for the drop; experts cite Two Sessions timing, Trump-Xi diplomacy, signaling, fuel constraints, and exercise prep as candidate factors.
